basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Forward Deployed Engineer · Production Agentic AI · GCP · Multi-Agent, RAG & Evals
basics.summary: Forward deployed engineer who ships production agentic AI into customer environments and stays accountable to the metric. 13+ years of shipping AI to real users, now through my own practice, Anand Creations: I embed with teams, lead technical discovery, and build multi-agent systems end to end. Current engagement LumApps, where agents on Python, LangGraph and GCP 2x outbound conversions and forecast $1M in quarterly revenue, backed by a temporal knowledge-graph AI brain that unifies 5+ silos into one memory for every agent; earlier, a Beekeeper LLM pipeline that cut $337K in vendor cost. I wire AI into existing systems over APIs and MCP servers, instrument every release with evals, granular tracing, and cost-per-request telemetry, and turn field patterns into reusable modules.

work.name: Lumapps
work.summary: Lead developer for production AI agents on GCP. Owns architecture, rollout, evaluation, and the conversion of field insights into product strategy. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes.
highlights: Shipped production multi-agent workflows for outbound sales on Python, LangGraph and Google ADK over GCP Vertex AI, using ReAct, self-reflection and hierarchical delegation with tools exposed via MCP servers. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day. Forecast: $4M in approved opportunities per quarter; at 25% conversion, $1M in quarterly revenue.

Built AI Brain, a context layer that ingests structured and unstructured signals (conversation data, usage analytics, notes) into a Neo4j and Graphiti knowledge graph, powering RAG retrieval for downstream agents.

Led technical discovery through production: agent architecture, evaluation harnesses, granular tracing, and latency and cost-per-request instrumentation, with agent state streamed to the frontend over AG-UI.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead operating like a founding engineer. Owns the problem, designs the solution, ships to prod, stays accountable to the metric. Shipped AI-powered products used by millions while growing the AI engineering team around me.
highlights: Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an in-house LLM pipeline built in 6 weeks (GitHub Actions, OpenAI APIs, evaluation gates). 12K+ key-value pairs translated; product team iterates without external gatekeepers.

Wired a GenAI demo system into Salesforce and live customer data, auto-generating personalized streams from name, description, and CRM context: connective tissue between AI and legacy data silos. Improved demo speed and close rates.
Built AI Onboarding Specialist, a personalized agent that gives every new signup high-touch guided setup at scale. 100% of customers guided through onboarding without adding headcount.
Hired and mentored the AI engineering cohort (deputy tech lead of FUEL). Co-built with PM and Sales on launches with instrumentation so we knew within a week if it moved the needle.

work.name: Tenity
work.summary: Technology panelist and mentor for seed-to-VC stage startups. Runs technical discovery, evaluates AI readiness, and advises on architecture, scaling, and shipping.
highlights: Led technical discovery sessions with founders and engineering teams across 20+ startups on architecture, scalability, and AI readiness to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions.
Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading systems in production; advised multiple portfolio companies on AI strategy and engineering culture.

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery system. Built everything from scratch: architecture, infrastructure, APIs, and the algorithms that made 500+ real-world deliveries possible.
highlights: Shipped end-to-end autonomous drone delivery platform (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL, AWS). 500+ successful last-mile deliveries; partnerships with Unilever and a showcase at CES Las Vegas.
Engineered real-time flight control APIs, logistics optimization, and CI/CD from scratch. 40% faster deliveries, 99.5% safety record, zero incidents.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
work.summary: AI research at the frontier of robotics. Built and scaled Robogen, an open-source platform for the co-evolution of robot morphologies and control systems via genetic algorithms. Foundational AI work underpinning my current LLM and agentic systems craft.
highlights: Engineered Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot bodies and brains via genetic algorithms. Morphology and neural control evolve together through artificial selection.
Migrated the simulation pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel evolution runs impractical on local hardware. Secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research; work featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Foundational AI experience (optimization, search, fitness landscapes, learning from environment) that informs how I approach modern LLM and agentic systems today.

_jobApplication.jobTitle: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, GenAI, Google Cloud
_jobApplication.jobDescription: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, GenAI, Google Cloud — Zürich, Switzerland. Minimum qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience; 8 years of experience building and shipping production-grade AI-driven solutions to external or internal customers using Python, TypeScript or comparable languages; leading technical discovery sessions with business stakeholders and engineering teams; designing and building AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., GCP); building pipelines for structured and unstructured data, incorporating vector databases and RAG-like architectures. Preferred: Master's/PhD in AI/CS; multi-agent systems with LangGraph, CrewAI, or Google ADK using ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation; knowledge of LLM-native metrics (tokens/sec, cost-per-request), state management, and granular tracing. As a GenAI Forward Deployed Engineer at Google Cloud, you will be an embedded builder bridging the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality for customers. You will code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions in the customer's environment. Responsibilities: lead developer for AI applications, transitioning prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (multi-agent systems, MCP servers) that drive measurable ROI; architect and code connective tissue between Google's AI products and customer's live infrastructure (APIs, legacy data silos, security perimeters); build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks for accuracy, safety, latency; identify repeatable field patterns and convert them into reusable modules or product feature requests; mentor talent and co-build with customer teams.
